notes: All 277 Kind-bearing draft entries kept; only the 3 bookkeeping scalars that were never Kind-bearing nodes are dropped -- Root (the draft's own flow-id pointer), PublishedAt (a timestamp), _meta_version (a version counter).

The draft's 'PublishedBy' audit record (Kind User, the capture's only User-kind node) mints as User_Sample01; its '_id' is set to that minted key and its 'Name' to the generic placeholder 'Sample Publisher' -- deidentified explicitly since its own identity field is '_id', not the generic 'Id' every other node uses.
The one personal email in this capture ('nachawon....') is replaced with 'sample.user@example.com' wherever it appears -- one Expression node's ExpressionStr, one AST Node's Static 'Value'.

KEPT verbatim on purpose: the company-domain validation regex '^[a-z.]+@cjexpress.co.th$', the employee-id regex '^CJ[A-Z]\d{7}$', every Thai display Name/Hint/Description, the two cjexpress.kissflow.com URLs inside Column rich-text Descriptions (the process URL's real flow-name path segment genericized to Template_Flow_Sample), the duplicate 'Manager Approve' Activity, and the orphaned SendBackToInitiator activity (both dangle out of ProcessDef::Activity in the source capture itself, a real quirk, not a bug this script introduces or repairs).

UNLIKE spikes/deidentify_template.py (the identity/initiate SHELL), this script does NOT synthesize the mandatory root Model::Appearance -> Appearance -> Style chain that the source capture is missing -- full fidelity means shipping the gap. A Template Transplant consuming this shape must build that chain itself before publish, same as any process built from scratch (see kissflow-forge CLAUDE.md 'Node-graph invariants').

Ids are freshly minted <Kind>_SampleNN, numbered per-kind in sorted-original-id order -- deterministic across re-runs of this script, but NOT stable if the raw capture ever changes (re-run and re-review, don't hand-edit the output).

ExpressionStr field refs are rewritten to minted ids in BOTH forms the source mixes freely -- bare ('pbf_req_id') and underscore ('_is_public_form') -- keeping the formula text id-synced with its remapped AST (shapes/expression_branch.json's 'keep both in sync' invariant); the platform's own system-field tokens ('_created_by', '_submitted_at') are left untouched.

Component_Sample01's 'ComponentId' keeps the raw capture value Component_oKkCjtMhB6 -- a cross-graph reference to a platform widget definition OUTSIDE this draft (it resolves to no node here in the source either). A Template Transplant must resolve or re-point it on the target tenant; minting it here would fabricate a node that never existed.

15 nodes keep references to production datasets outside this shape (LHSModel/LHSRootModel/SourceFlowId values like Department_Master_01, Master_Branch, Tier1, _employee, User) -- tenant-only refs a Template Transplant must re-point at dev sources per ADR-0006; they dangle by design in the vendored shape.
